messages:
Jordan P: hey team, Jordan here — first day in CS :wave: quick setup Qs so I can be productive: HubSpot (prod), Aircall seat, Gong/call-library, and the objection cheatsheet. also i'm seeing multiple playbook files — which one is the canonical live playbook? who do I ping for each?
Sam (IT): welcome Jordan! Sent HubSpot invite to jordan@redwood (check spam). HubSpot will ask for Okta MFA. Aircall seat request is pending; depending on region we provision Aircall or Dialpad. if you want sandbox vs prod let me know.
Priya (sales-ops): hi Jordan :tada: canonical playbook is named "cs_playbook_master" in /playbooks/cs (we keep older copies suffixed _archive). Objection cheatsheet is "CS_OBJECTION_BRIEF" under /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets. I'll add you to both folders and share direct links.
Marco (CS): looped you into Gong and the call-library; flagged two calls to listen to (onboarding + escalation). I'll schedule a 30-min playbook walkthrough after your tools are live.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: complete the "Sales/CS Tools" checklist within 48 hours to avoid seat delays: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs
Jordan P: accepted HubSpot and set up MFA. Aircall invite came but the one-time setup link failed with "token expired".
Sam (IT): thanks for the heads up — resent Aircall invite and escalated to the vendor for token issues. In the meantime try Aircall mobile or the web app; I can reissue a fresh link if needed.
Jordan P: Aircall mobile worked, headset tested. thanks! one more item: where are the outbound macros / templates in Notion?
Priya (sales-ops): I maintain macros — template name is "cs_outbound_v1" in Notion under Sales > CS templates. I'll grant you access and drop a quick starter pack.
Marco (CS): FYI recordings are ON by default for training. If you want recordings disabled for a particular customer/demo, follow the rec-off steps in the playbook and loop compliance.
Jordan P: perfect — got access to everything. appreciate the fast help, excited to get started :rocket:
